verdict.rationale: A documented test environment for a government registry's machine channel is a fair question, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only a live keyless open-data API on the Socrata platform (data.colorado.gov) and filing pages; nothing documents a public sandbox or test environment for exercising the rail before production.

support.subject: As a developer, a public sandbox or test environment for the service's machine channel is documented — I can exercise the rail end to end before touching production
